title: Section A — Counting and addition — Q1
body:
Maya has 2 red apples and 3 green apples. How many apples does she have altogether?
Student work: 2 + 3 = 5 apples!
criteria: Exactly 2 pts for answer 5. Exactly 1 pt if counting or addition work is shown but the total is wrong. Otherwise 0.

title: Section A — Counting and addition — Q2
body:
What is 3 + 4?
Student work: 7 (counted on fingers)
criteria: Exactly 2 pts for answer 7. Exactly 1 pt if a counting attempt is shown (e.g. fingers) but the answer is wrong. Otherwise 0.

title: Section A — Counting and addition — Q3
criteria: Exactly 2 pts for answer 4. Exactly 1 pt if counting-back work is shown but the final answer is wrong. Otherwise 0.

title: Section B — Shapes and comparing — Q4
body:
How many sides does a triangle have?
Student work: 3 sides

title: Section B — Shapes and comparing — Q5
body:
